description: A couple rent a vacation home haunted by the spirits of the architect who built it and his two wives, as well as their deranged, living son.

title: After.Life
description: Following a terrible car crash, a woman (Christina Ricci) awakes to find an enigmatic mortician (Liam Neeson) preparing her for burial.

description: Following a double corneal transplant, a concert violinist (Jessica Alba) perceives frightening images of a world that only she can see.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: After being hypnotized at a party, a man (Kevin Bacon) has visions of deaths and of a girl who disappeared six months earlier.

description: Capt. Ted Cogan (Rob Lowe) returns from the war in Iraq and is haunted by visions of a burned man. After he is denied help by the government, a psychic tells him to find out what the burned man wants.

title: Mara
description: A criminal psychologist investigates the mysterious strangling death of a man in his bed. She soon meets members of a community who tell her about a centuries-old demon that kills people in their sleep.
